title: The Keeper
blurb: The worst storm of the year kills the power, the lighthouse beacon dies, and the old keeper is hurt at the foot of the stairs — just as a boat's lights struggle offshore. Keeping the great lamp burning by hand is on you now. You have until first light to hold the beam, and whoever the sea sends, against the dark.

identity.name: Tempest
identity.mood: A storm-black coast; the only light is the beam that keeps ships off the rocks.

line.en: The light goes out in the storm. A boat out past the rocks needs the beam you keep burning.
line.fr: La lumière s'éteint dans la tempête. Au large des rochers, un bateau a besoin du feu que vous gardez allumé.
line.es: La luz se apaga en la tormenta. Más allá de las rocas, un barco necesita el faro que mantienes encendido.
line.it: La luce si spegne nella tempesta. Oltre gli scogli, una barca ha bisogno del faro che tieni acceso.
line.de: Das Licht erlischt im Sturm. Draußen hinter den Felsen braucht ein Boot den Schein, den du am Brennen hältst.
line.pt: A luz apaga-se na tempestade. Para lá dos rochedos, um barco precisa do farol que manténs aceso.
line.ru: Свет гаснет в шторм. Там, за скалами, лодке нужен луч, который ты не даёшь погаснуть.
line.zh: 灯在风暴中熄灭了。礁石之外，一条船需要你守住的那束光。
line.ar: ينطفئ الضوء في العاصفة. خلف الصخور، يحتاج قاربٌ إلى النور الذي تُبقيه مشتعلاً.

hero.sub: A story where you are the hero — and every choice turns you to a new page. Written for people learning English, at your level, with meaning in your language whenever you need it.
